repair_selection: First 32 tasks in frozen training order that failed both initial and sampled attempts; one feedback repair each
final_evaluation: Native MBPP test split stays untouched throughout this experiment, including conditional replication
promotion: No automatic promotion; retain parent and report development replication only
failure_policy: Preserve failures and reservations; no automatic retry or additional stage. Infrastructure failure blocks dependent stages.
reference_policy: Freeze proposals and independent domain review before probing. Require original reference tests to pass and at least 3 distinct supported added calls. Reference-derived expectations are not a proof of reference correctness. Freeze audited dataset before any model generation.
